evidence.title: New release: Seiko 5 Sports collaboration with Honda Motocompo :
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Press release information with commentary in italics . [e001:f02] HDB010 is EUR 390 . [e001:f03] Commentary The Motocompo is an interesting little recreational motorcycle by Honda, produced from 1981 to 1983, designed to fit inside the trunk of a subcompact car. [e001:f04] Original models in good condition typically fetch from USD 5k to USD 10k in today’s market. [e001:f05] The Motocompo fits into the tiny boot of a car like the Honda City, shown here in an article on Car and Driver (1982). [e001:f06] This interesting collaboration with the Seiko 5. [e001:f07] This release is a celebration of compactness and ingenuity of design and launched on the 45th anniversary of Motocompo. [e001:f08] The watch is based on the Seiko 5 Sports Field Collection . [e001:f09] The dial colour chosen by Seiko is the sunshine yellow which was part of the 1981 launch of the motor vehicle. [e001:f10] This is a brilliant yellow splashed on the dial safe for a black strip running from 9 to 3 o’clock with the Honda logo and the Day/Date window. [e001:f11] One interesting observation is that the watch at EUR 390 or USD 370 costs as much as the Honda Motocompo back in 1981. [e001:f12] Release details The iconic design of the ultra-compact MOTOCOMPO has been incorporated into the Field series, featuring a compact case with a 36.4mm diameter. [MOTOCOMPO] A recreational motorcycle released by Honda Motor Co., Ltd. in 1981. [e001:f13] Targeting trend-conscious young people as its main customers, the MOTOCOMPO proposed a new six-wheeled lifestyle that combined the comfort of a four-wheeled vehicle with the maneuverability of a two-wheeler by allowing it to be stored in the trunk of the “CITY,” a compact car released at the same time. [e001:f14] Screenshot The dial features the striking yellow color of the MOTOCOMPO, with the HONDA logo emblazoned along the black section that cuts across the center. [e001:f15] Furthermore, drawing inspiration from the attachment point used to secure the MOTOCOMPO to a car with a strap, part of the watch’s strap bears the inscription “CARRYING POINT,” while the tip of the strap is marked “INSERTION POINT.” As a feature unique to this limited-edition model, the case back is marked with the silhouette of the MOTOCOMPO, the words “Limited Edition,” and a serial number. evidence.title: FIA announce update to F1 race start times for rest of 2026 season
evidence.body: [e003:f01] An updated F1 2026 calendar has now been released showing all of the session start times, after the adding to the schedule of another race weekend. [e003:f02] Two grand prix weekends were cancelled in April due to the conflict in the Middle East, with both Bahrain and Saudi Arabia falling off the schedule. [e003:f03] That left the 2026 season as a 22-race season, with doubt over the Qatar and Abu Dhabi Grands Prix at the end of the season still in place due to the ongoing situation in the Middle East. [e003:f04] This race in Malaysia is scheduled for the weekend of October 2-4, creating a triple header with the Azerbaijan and Singapore Grands Prix either side. [e003:f05] The Bahrain Grand Prix is usually a night race, but the latest FIA schedule announcement has made it clear that it will not be played out in the dark at the Sepang Circuit, instead taking place at 3pm local time (8am BST). [e003:f06] F1 SCHEDULE: Every race date for 2026 plus TV details Bahrain (Malaysia) Grand Prix schedule The reinstated Bahrain GP in Malaysia will not be a sprint race weekend , and there are only two of those remaining in 2026, set to take place at the Dutch GP and the Singapore GP. [e003:f07] Bahrain will see the usual three practice sessions, qualifying and the grand prix taking place on the Sunday. [e003:f08] The action gets underway on Friday October 2, with FP1 starting at 12:30pm local time (5am BST) and FP2 at 4pm (9am BST). [e003:f09] Saturday October 3 then has the same session times compared to Friday for FP3 and qualifying respectively, before the Bahrain Grand Prix gets underway on Sunday October 4 at 3pm local time (8am BST). [e003:f10] F1 2026 calendar quirks While none of the other timings for the remainder of the 2026 season have changed, there does remain some doubt as to whether the final two race weekends in Qatar and Abu Dhabi can take place. [e003:f11] F1 have admitted that there are contingency plans in place, and have given themselves until the middle of September to decide once and for all whether the season-ending races will be in those countries. [e003:f12] Alternatively, the season finale could be held in the middle of the European winter instead, Stefano Domenicali has revealed , with Imola, Portimao in Portugal and Turkey all being cited as potential venues in that scenario. [e003:f13] The latest calendar announcement has also confirmed that the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix will be on a Saturday. [e003:f14] It was decided before the season that this would be the case, making it the first Saturday F1 grand prix since the 2024 Saudi Arabian Grand Prix. [e003:f15] The reason for this is because the Sunday clashes with Azerbaijan's national remembrance day. [e003:f16] It means that FP1 and FP2 will be on Thursday, with FP3 and qualifying on the Friday, and the Azerbaijan GP being on Saturday, September 26 at 3pm local time (12pm UK time).

evidence.title: FIA hits back at criticism and blames manufacturers for delay in F1 2026 rule changes
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Nikolas Tombazis stated that the FIA identified potential flaws in advance, but the governance framework prevented changes prior to the debut of Formula 1's new regulations. [e005:f02] The Fédération Internationale de l’Automobile (FIA) has responded to driver criticism regarding Formula 1’s 2026 technical regulations, claiming it had anticipated many of the issues long before the season got underway. [e005:f03] According to the governing body, however, desired changes were blocked by a lack of consensus among power unit manufacturers. [e005:f04] Speaking to The Race , Nikolas Tombazis, the FIA’s single-seater director, explained that the organization had identified well in advance several of the difficulties highlighted by drivers throughout the season. [e005:f05] However, he emphasized that the existing governance model prevented the implementation of proposed modifications before the new regulations debuted. [e005:f06] As part of the agreement signed between the FIA, Formula 1, and the manufacturers for the introduction of the 2026 rules, any changes to the power units required approval from the governing body, Formula One Management (FOM), and at least four of the five manufacturers involved in the project. [e005:f07] We anticipated many of the issues they pointed out in the two years leading up to the season and tried to make some adjustments. [e005:f08] Nikolas Tombazis (Photo: AFP) Tombazis explained that the lack of consensus among manufacturers made any relevant changes impossible prior to the new rules coming into force. [e005:f09] “Any change needed to be approved by a significant number of power unit manufacturers. [e005:f10] For the kind of alteration we carried out, we needed the agreement of at least four of them, and that never happened during the years we discussed these adjustments,” he stressed. [e005:f11] Following the opening rounds of the season, Formula 1 introduced a series of emergency measures to mitigate energy management issues, which were rolled out starting at the Miami GP. [e005:f12] Furthermore, the FIA and manufacturers agreed to adjust the nominal power split between the internal combustion engine and the electrical system—abandoning the 50/50 ratio in favor of a 60% combustion / 40% electrical distribution through the end of this regulatory cycle in 2028. [e005:f13] Despite the agreement, Tombazis expressed regret that the changes were only approved after the 2026 season was already underway. [e005:f14] We discussed these matters in May to define the package for 2027 and 2028. [e005:f15] Formula 1 is currently on summer break. [e005:f16] The series resumes 2026 season action from August 21 to 23 with the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort.

evidence.title: Ferrari poach Mercedes F1 star as double signing ramps up title fight
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Ferrari have acquired the signature of a star of the Mercedes F1 team, strengthening the Italian squad ahead of what could be a spicy title fight against Toto Wolff's outfit. [e004:f02] At the midway point in the 2026 campaign, Ferrari sit comfortably in second place, 72 points behind Mercedes in the constructors' standings. [e004:f03] Seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton is now leading the Scuderia's fight against his former team in the drivers' championship as well, with the British superstar 50 points shy of leading the title race, a position currently held by 19-year-old Kimi Antonelli. [e004:f04] Article continues under video And despite the summer shutdown being well underway after the Hungarian Grand Prix last time out, the transfer market is well and truly awake, especially where technical staff are concerned. [e004:f05] F1 HEADLINES: Verstappen to Aston Martin, Mercedes cost cap fears and Sky F1's uncertain future Mercedes and Aston Martin lose key F1 players to Ferrari At the start of the summer break, former Aston Martin stress engineer Carlos Sanchez Martinez announced his decision to depart the Silverstone squad after eight years in favour of joining the Scuderia. [e004:f06] Having watched the team transform from Racing Point into Aston Martin and celebrated many highs from Sergio Perez 's first win at the Sakhir GP to Fernando Alonso 's podium resurgence in 2023, Martinez shared that he had decided to leave Aston Martin to take up the opportunity of, 'a new challenge in F1, a new team, and new colours.' He will now join Ferrari as a chassis stress engineering specialist. [e004:f07] Just one week after Martinez's announcement, Mercedes man Luciano Nicomede has revealed his choice to do the same. [e004:f08] The ex-composite design engineer was a vital part of Mercedes' F1 chassis department and despite working with the Silver Arrows since 2020 he has now sided with Ferrari in a worrying development for Wolff's squad. [e004:f09] Nicomede announced his move on LinkedIn , revealing he had taken up the role of senior chassis composite designer in a step up with Fred Vasseur's outfit, marking a strategic swoop for his talents by the Maranello F1 squad. [e004:f10] "Joining Ferrari is a significant milestone in my career and an exciting opportunity to contribute to a team renowned for its engineering excellence, innovation, and pursuit of performance. [e004:f11] "I look forward to the challenges ahead, continuing to grow professionally, and contributing to the team’s success. [e004:f12] "I’m grateful for this opportunity and excited for what lies ahead. [e004:f13] "Here’s to a new beginning!

evidence.title: 【Ｆ１】アストンマーティンに危機 主要スタッフがフェラーリに電撃移籍「引き抜かれてしまった」（東スポWEB）
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 今季からアストンマーティンとホンダがタッグを組んだが、開幕から歴史的な低迷が続いていた。 [e006:f02] しかし26日のハンガリー・グランプリ（GP）決勝では大型アップデート（改良）効果により、ランス・ストロールが13位、フェルナンド・アロンソが14位と驚異のジャンプアップを見せた。 [e006:f03] アストンマーティンは今後〝アップデート攻勢〟をかける方針。 [e006:f04] 夏季休暇明け初戦となるオランダGP（決勝＝8月23日）では、ホンダのパワーユニット（PU）が大きな進化を遂げるとみられている。 [e006:f05] しかし、チームを支えてきた主要スタッフがフェラーリに電撃移籍して波紋を呼んでいる。 [e006:f06] 英メディア「GPファンズ」は「フェラーリがアストンマーティンからF1の主要スタッフを引き抜く」と報道。 [e006:f07] 「今後数シーズンにわたってフェラーリのような強豪に近づこうとする中で、アストンマーティンはエンジニアの一人をスクーデリアに引き抜かれてしまった。 [e006:f08] アストンマーティンの応力解析エンジニア、カルロス・サンチェス・マルティネスは現在フェラーリで働いており、英国GPが彼にとってアストンマーティンでの最後のレースとなった」と伝えた。 [e006:f09] マルティネス氏はアストンマーティンを支えてきた重要人物の一人だ。 [e006:f10] 「2019年に、アストンマーティンがレーシングポイントと呼ばれていた時代に入社し、ジュニア応力解析エンジニアを務めていた。 [e006:f11] そして「フェラーリでの彼の役割は、さらに上のレベルと言えるだろう。 [e006:f12] マルティネスは、7月にフェラーリでシャシー応力解析スペシャリストとして働き始めた。 [e006:f13] マラネロを拠点とするフェラーリは、08年以来となる世界チャンピオンの座を目指している」とV奪回を目指す名門に要職で引き抜かれた。 [e006:f14] マルティネス氏は移籍に際して「素晴らしい人々や、モータースポーツ史上最高のドライバーたちと共に過ごした、まさに人生における信じられないほど素晴らしい時期でした。 [e006:f15] そして「今こそ、F1における新たな挑戦、新たなチーム、そして新たなカラーリングの時だ」とフェラーリでの仕事に意欲を見せている。 [e006:f16] 東スポWEB 【関連記事】 【F1】角田裕毅の〝GT3〟参戦プランが消滅「レッドブルによって阻止された」 【F1】アストンマーティンの新マシンは「ストレートは本当に遅い」コラピントが不吉な警告 【F1】「次のステップは新型ホンダエンジンだ」BBC特集 〝0・5秒〟短縮可能と太鼓判 【F1】フェルスタッペン流出阻止へ レッドブルが総額1億ユーロの「天文学的」オファー 【F1】アロンソが夏季休暇中に〝引退を決断〟の衝撃予測「今年が彼にとって最後の年になる」＝英メディア。

evidence.title: ZIPAIR、第1四半期は6.5%の旅客増収 Starlink全機搭載と柔軟な価格戦略で単価・搭乗率が大幅向上
evidence.body: [e007:f01] 同四半期のZIPAIRの旅客収入は、前年同期の210億円から223億円へと順調に拡大しています。 [e007:f02] この好業績を牽引したのは、機内環境の向上と緻密な販売戦略です。 [e007:f03] 同社は高速インターネットサービス「Starlink」の全機搭載を完了させてプロダクト価値を大幅に引き上げるとともに、市場動向に応じた柔軟な価格戦略を展開しており、これが需要の獲得と増収に大きく貢献したとしています。 [e007:f04] 運航実績からは、徹底した効率化と収益性の向上が読み取れます。 [e007:f05] 有効座席キロ（ASK）を前年同期比8.9%減と意図的に供給を絞り込んだ一方で、有償旅客キロ（RPK）は4.5%増、有償旅客数も1.9%増の35万5000人を記録しました。 [e007:f06] この結果、有償座席利用率は前年の77.1%から11.3ポイントも急上昇し、88.5%という極めて高い稼働水準に達しています。 [e007:f07] さらに、これらの取り組みは顧客単価の向上にも直結しています。 [e007:f08] 旅客一人当たりの単価は前年同期の60,333円から4.5%上昇し、63,029円となりました。 [e007:f09] 供給を適正化して座席の希少価値を高めつつ、付加価値の高いサービスを提供することで単価を引き上げるという、LCCとしての理想的なビジネスモデルが機能していると考えられます。 [e007:f10] ZIPAIR、2026年10月20日に東京/成田～クアラルンプール線に就航 5社競合路線に ZIPAIR、高速インターネット「Starlink」の全機搭載を完了 ZIPAIR、2026年冬スケジュールのヒューストン・バンクーバー・シンガポール線で増便を決定 Related posts: JAL、傘下LCCのジップエアとスプリングジャパンの業績を発表 両社共に年間利用率は7割越え JAL、傘下LCCのジップエアとスプリングジャパンの2025年3月期連結業績を発表 ジップエアの好調さが目立つ JAL、傘下LCCのジップエアとスプリングジャパンの2025年度第2四半期業績を発表 ジップエアは搭乗率が低下 エアージャパン、2024年第1四半期の搭乗率は51.9%と厳しい船出 ピーチは84.9%。

evidence.title: SpaceX初決算｜イーロン・マスクが幹部の発言をたびたび
evidence.body: [e002:f01] イーロン・マスクCEOが同社の将来について次々と大きな数字を口にする一方、隣に座るCOOとCFOは、より抑制の効いた言葉でそれを語り直していました。 [e002:f02] 8月4日の決算説明会でマスクCEOは、従来より帯域幅を高めた新型「V3」Starlink衛星の打ち上げを控える中、Starlinkが「10年足らず」で「世界のインターネットの過半」を担うと述べたが、COOのショットウェル氏は「世界のインターネットトラフィックのかなりの部分」とより抑えた表現を用いた。 [e002:f03] CFOのジョンセン氏は年末までにARR（年間換算収益）1,000億ドル到達という見通しを示したが、マスク氏は20分後「それより高くなる」と上乗せした。 [e002:f04] From: Elon Musk repeatedly one-upped his execs on SpaceX’s first earnings call 【編集部解説】 SpaceXの決算説明会でマスク氏が幹部の発言に次々と数字を上乗せしていく、という構図自体は、記事が指摘する通りです。 [e002:f05] SpaceXは、買収目的会社（Merger Sub）のX67社を通じて6月16日、Cursorの開発元Anysphere社を約600億ドルで買収する契約を締結しており、完了は第3四半期の見込みです。 [e002:f06] 一方、収益1兆ドル到達を2031年から2030年に前倒しするという発言と、耐熱シールドについて「問題は解決した」と言い切った発言には、その場で対比する幹部の発言がありません。 [e002:f07] 8月4日発表の第2四半期決算では、売上高が前年同期比92%増の78億ドルとなり、市場予想を上回りました。 [e002:f08] SpaceXにとってこれは上場後最初の決算説明会であり、次の四半期以降、発言と実績の照合が本格的に始まります。 [e002:f09] SpaceX、Cursor買収でAmazon超え ― 時価総額2.9兆ドルへ急騰の真相 編集部解説で触れた「Cursor」の正体（買収案件）を解説。 [e002:f10] 6月28日【今日は何の日】SpaceX上場でトリリオネア誕生、イーロン・マスク55歳の現在地 IPO・xAI統合・Cursor買収を含む2026年のSpaceX/マスク氏の動きを俯瞰。 [e002:f11] Cursor（公式サイト） （外部） SpaceX（子会社SpaceXAI）が約600億ドルで買収を進めるAIコーディングツール。 [e002:f12] 【参考記事】 SpaceX revenue surges 92% to $7.8 billion, blowing past Wall Street expectations by nearly $1 billion — Fortune （外部） SpaceXの第2四半期決算を報道。 [e002:f13] 売上高78億ドル（前年比92%増）、Starlink加入者数が1,200万人に倍増したと伝える。 [e002:f14] SpaceX earnings takeaways: Soaring AI costs outweigh revenue beat in first report since IPO — CNBC （外部） 決算の詳細な数値（設備投資額、ARR目標の根拠となった契約額等）と、AI関連コストの急増を分析している。 [e002:f15] SpaceX to acquire the AI coding startup Cursor for $60 billion — CNBC （外部） SpaceXがAnysphere（Cursor開発元）を600億ドルの全株式交換で買収すると発表。 [e002:f16] SpaceX quarterly revenue surges in debut results as satellite, AI businesses surge — Reuters （外部） Starlink収益66%増、AI事業収益250%増など、事業セグメント別の成長率を報じている。

evidence.title: NASA provides update on SpaceX Crew‑13 mission to the International Space Station
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The mission, which is currently targeted for mid-September, will send a four-person crew to the ISS. [e003:f02] What we know: The Crew-13 mission will carry NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney, Canadian Space Agency (CSA) astronaut Joshua Kutryk, and Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov to the ISS. [e003:f03] Timeline: A SpaceX Dragon spacecraft will launch on a Falcon 9 rocket from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida no earlier than mid-September. [e003:f04] The crew will participate in a number of science experiments, potential space walks, and ISS maintenance. [e003:f05] During the briefing, NASA astronaut Jessica Watkins, who will serve as commander, discussed the mission and pilot Luke Delaney gave an overview of the science studies that will be taking place. [e003:f06] What they're saying: "I personally am looking forward to returning to the ISS, as well as flying on Dragon a second time, and really looking forward to experiencing those experiences through the eyes of my crew mates. [e003:f07] We will be joining Expedition 75, already in progress on board the International Space Station. [e003:f08] We'll be contributing to that as well, taking the baton from Crew 12 and continuing to participate in our continuous human presence on ISS," said Watkins. [e003:f09] So some stem cell growth studies will be going on with plants as well. [e003:f10] So we're looking for developing plant habitats potentially aboard the station throughout station if we desire, but also in a sustainable habitat that'll be up there as well," said Delaney. [e003:f11] Dig deeper: Crew-13 is the 13th crew rotation mission of SpaceX's human space transportation system and the 14th flight with astronauts, including the Demo-2 test flight, to the space station through NASA's Commercial Crew Program. [e003:f12] Meet the members of the Crew-13 mission NASA’s SpaceX Crew-13 members are pictured in their pressure suits seated inside a mockup Dragon spacecraft during a preflight training session at the company’s headquarters in Hawthorne, California. [e003:f13] From left are Roscosmos Sergey Teteryatnikov, NASA Expand The four-person crew selected for the mission include: Jessica Watkins , a NASA astronaut, who will serve as commander of the mission. [e003:f14] Luke Delaney , a NASA astronaut, who will serve as pilot. [e003:f15] Joshua Kutryk , a Canadian Space Agency astronaut, who will serve as a mission specialist. evidence.title: SpaceX launches 24 Starlink satellites on Falcon 9 rocket from Vandenberg SFB
evidence.body: [e004:f01] SpaceX is set to launch its 90th Falcon 9 rocket of the year with a mid-morning flight from Vandenberg Space Force Base on Tuesday. [e004:f02] It comes hours before the company’s first quarterly earnings call as a publicly traded company. [e004:f03] The Starlink 17-53 mission will add another 24 broadband internet satellites to the company’s low Earth orbit constellation consisting of more than 10,800 satellites. [e004:f04] Liftoff from Space Launch Complex 4 East is scheduled for 10:05 a.m. [e004:f05] The rocket will fly on a south-southwesterly trajectory upon leaving the pad. [e004:f06] Spaceflight Now will have live coverage beginning about 30 minutes prior to liftoff. ﻿ SpaceX will launch the mission using the Falcon 9 first stage booster with the tail number B1063. [e004:f07] This will be its 34th flight after launching missions for NASA, ESA, the National Reconnaissance Office and the Space Development Agency, among others. [e004:f08] Nearly 8.5 minutes after liftoff, B1063 will target a landing on the droneship, Of Course I Still Love You , positioned in the Pacific Ocean. [e004:f09] If successful, this will be the 215th landing on this vessel and the 644th booster landing to date for SpaceX. [e004:f10] SpaceX will host its first earnings call in company history about 30 minutes after the markets close at 4 p.m. [e004:f11] The financial update comes as the company is preparing for what may be the first orbital launch of its Starship rocket with the Flight 14 mission on a yet-to-be-announced launch date. [e004:f12] The company is also preparing for marquee missions for NASA with the launch of the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope set to fly on a Falcon Heavy rocket no earlier than August 30 and the Crew-13 mission flying on a Falcon 9 rocket no earlier than September 12. evidence.title: イーロン・マスク氏、SpaceX上場前を下回る資産に後退 現在は6,840億ドル
evidence.body: [e005:f01] イーロン・マスク 氏の推定資産は先月のピークである1兆3,300億ドルから急減し、現在は6,840億ドル。 [e005:f02] SpaceXの歴史的IPO前の水準を下回り、「ポスト上場マネーゲーム」の傷の深さを浮き彫りにしている。 [e005:f03] ポイント マスク氏の資産は6月16日前後に1兆3,300億ドル近辺まで膨らんだが、足元では6,840億ドルに減少。 [e005:f04] SpaceX株は終値ベースの高値から46％安となり、108.37ドルの上場来安値を記録。 [e005:f05] 上場後初の決算発表（8月4日）から2日後の8月6日に、最大9億1,150万株のインサイダー株が売却可能に。 [e005:f06] SpaceX株急落で「紙の1兆長者」から転落 Space Exploration Technologies Corp.（SpaceX）の株価は、6月16日に付けた終値高値201.80ドルから 急落 し、上場来安値の108.37ドルまで約46％下落した。 [e005:f07] 先週、テキサス南部のスター・ベース基地からの大型ロケット「スターシップ」の打ち上げに成功したものの、相場の下げ止まりにはつながっていない。 [e005:f08] ブルームバーグ・ビリオネア指数によると、マスク氏が保有するSpaceX株の評価額はなお5,500億ドル超と見積もられ、 テスラ 株の持分は1,290億ドル規模と算定される。 [e005:f09] それでも、わずか1カ月強で6,000億ドル超が吹き飛んだ計算で、この減少幅は、世界の富豪上位500人に名を連ねたどの人物の純資産合計よりも大きい。 [e005:f10] 唯一の例外がマスク氏自身という構図だ。 [e005:f11] テスラ株も下落に拍車をかけており、第2四半期決算を公表した7月22日以降で17％安、昨年12月高値から36％下で取引されている。

evidence.title: SpaceX、IPO後初の決算で売上高92％増 AI設備投資158億ドルで「2030年には年商1兆ドルに」とマスクCEO
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 売上高は前年同期比92％増の78億1400万ドル。 [e006:f02] 純損失は5億4100万ドル（1株当たり9セント）で、前年同期の10億800万ドルから4億6700万ドル改善した。 [e006:f03] 通信セグメント概要（画像：SpaceX） 一方、設備投資は183億6900万ドルと前年同期の6.5倍に膨らみ、うち158億2800万ドルをAI分野に充てた。 [e006:f04] 成長率が最も高かったのはAIセグメントで、売上高は247％増の25億6100万ドル。 [e006:f05] 同社は2月にイーロン・マスクCEOのAI企業xAIと合併しており、AI事業を傘下に持つ。 [e006:f06] 増収は新たに結んだクラウドサービス契約が主因で、契約額は合計141億ドル。 [e006:f07] うち16億ドルが当四半期のAIインフラ売上の増加分となった。 [e006:f08] AIコーディングツールのCursorを600億ドルで買収する契約も結んでおり、第3四半期中の完了を見込む。 [e006:f09] 四半期末後の7月には、Cursorと共同で訓練し1.5兆パラメータの基盤モデル「V9」を組み込んだ「Grok 4.5」を公開した。 [e006:f10] 衛星通信「Starlink」を中心とする通信セグメントの売上高は66％増の42億9100万ドル。 [e006:f11] 政府向けの「Starshield」では、主に米宇宙軍との2件の契約により、米政府との複数年契約を60億ドル超獲得している。 [e006:f12] 宇宙輸送セグメントの売上高は29％増の9億6200万ドル。 [e006:f13] 四半期末後の7月の「Flight 13」では、量産版V3衛星20基の展開、宇宙空間でのRaptorエンジン再着火、過去最も緩やかな着水を達成し、無傷の耐熱シールドを確認できたとしている。 [e006:f14] ブレット・ジョンセンCFOが年末までに年換算売上が1000億ドルに到達する軌道にあると説明したのに対し、マスク氏は「何もしなくても達成する水準」だとして上振れを示唆。 [e006:f15] 売上高1兆ドル到達の社内予測を2031年から2030年に前倒ししたことも明らかにした。 [e006:f16] ITmedia NEWS 【関連記事】 SpaceX、xAIの正式名称を「SpaceXAI」に 新ロゴも公開 SpaceX、AIコーディングの「Cursor」を600億ドルで買収 上場直後の巨額投資 Gemini需要急増でGoogleがSpaceXと月額9億2000万ドルの大型契約 Anthropic、マスク氏のSpaceXと契約 GPU22万基超を確保し「Claude」の利用制限を緩和。

evidence.title: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, launching on a Falcon Heavy on 30 August 2026, carries a mirror the size of Hubble's but sees a patch of sky about a hundred times wider,
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is [scheduled to launch on 30 August 2026](https:// aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy from the Kennedy Space Center, well ahead of its official commitment to be ready by May 2027. [e002:f02] It is the biggest space astronomy launch since the James Webb Space Telescope, and it is built to do almost the opposite job. [e002:f03] Where Webb stares deep and narrow, Roman is designed to see wide. [e002:f04] I am a writer with a long interest in this beat, not an astronomer, so treat this as a careful reading of what the mission is meant to do rather than a promise about what it will find. ## A Hubble-sized eye with a far wider view Roman carries a primary mirror 2.4 metres across, exactly the size of the Hubble Space Telescope’s, made possible in part by optics originally handed to NASA by the National Reconnaissance Office. [e002:f05] According to [NASA’s description of the mission](https:// Roman’s Wide Field Instrument, a roughly 300-megapixel near-infrared camera, captures a patch of sky about a hundred times larger than Hubble does in a single exposure, at similar sharpness. [e002:f06] A view that would take Hubble a hundred separate pointings to build up, Roman takes in one. [e002:f07] It is less a device for photographing single objects beautifully and more a machine for surveying the sky at speed. ## What it is actually for Two big questions drive the mission. [e002:f08] The second is planets. [e002:f09] Roman will stare at the crowded star fields toward the centre of our galaxy and watch for gravitational microlensing, the brief brightening that happens when one star, and any planets around it, passes in front of another and bends its light. [e002:f10] Roman is the wide-angle companion to that deep gaze, and the two are meant to complement rather than repeat each other. [e002:f11] Its job is to block the overwhelming glare of a star so that the faint light of a planet beside it can be seen. [e002:f12] It uses deformable mirrors that flex in real time to cancel out stray starlight, and NASA describes it as the first active coronagraph of its kind in space, able to suppress a star’s glare far more than any previous space instrument. [e002:f13] A technology demonstration is meant to prove a method, not to deliver a catalogue, and its results should be read in that spirit. ## Ahead of schedule, for once One quietly notable thing about Roman is that it is early. [e002:f14] Large space telescopes have a long history of slipping years past their planned dates and swelling past their budgets, so a flagship arriving at the pad months ahead of its required readiness is worth remarking on. [e002:f15] Maps the Tension you’ve normalized, the Noise you hide behind, and the one truth your therapist is building toward but hasn’t said yet. [Take the quiz →](https:// The observatory has already been through the punishing pre-launch gauntlet: shaken to simulate the ride uphill, blasted with launch-level sound, and baked and frozen in a vacuum chamber to prove it can survive space. [e002:f16] Completing that on the early side is the unglamorous part of the story, and the part most likely to be forgotten the moment the first images arrive. ## What to watch next After the 30 August launch, Roman faces the same outbound trip as Webb did, out to the second Lagrange point about 1.5 million kilometres from Earth, followed by months of commissioning before any。

evidence.title: SpaceX上場後初決算、売上高倍増も売り圧力に抗えず AI設備投資が6倍に急増し時間外で6%超下落
evidence.body: [e005:f01] SpaceXは上場後初の決算を発表し、第2四半期の売上高は前年同期比92%増の78.1億ドル（約1.2兆円）と市場予想を上回った。 [e005:f02] 純損失は前年同期の10億ドル（約1,600億円）から5.41億ドル（約850億円）に縮小した。 [e005:f03] しかし、AIインフラへの設備投資が183.7億ドル（約2.9兆円）に急増したことで、収益見通しに対する投資家の懸念が強まり、時間外取引で株価が一時6%超下落した。 [e005:f04] イーロン・マスクCEOは、Nvidiaと協力しAI衛星コンピューティングペイロード「Starmind AI-1」を開発すると発表し、次世代Grokモデルの投入も予告した。 [e005:f05] 宇宙開発・人工知能（AI）大手のSpaceX（SPCX）は米東部時間4日の取引終了後、6月の過去最大規模の新規株式公開（IPO）を経て上場してから初となる決算を発表した。 [e005:f06] しかし、AIインフラへの設備投資が6倍以上に急増したことで、収益見通しに対する投資家の懸念が強まり、時間外取引で株価が一時6%超下落するなど、好調な事業基調と市場心理が激しく対立する展開となった。 [e005:f07] SpaceXの第2四半期の設備投資は183.7億ドル（約2.9兆円）と、前年同期の24億ドル（約3,800億円）から6倍以上に急増し、アナリスト予想の132.2億ドル（約2.1兆円）も大きく上回った。 [e005:f08] このうち、158.3億ドル（約2.5兆円）もの資金がAI関連の建設に投じられており、これは足元のハイテク大手決算シーズンで市場が抱いている、AI投資の収益性に対する懸念と軌を一にするものだ。 [e005:f09] ジョンセン氏はまた、年末までに年間経常収益（ARR）が1,000億ドル（約15.8兆円）を突破する見込みであり、今四半期開始から数週間で、67億ドル（約1.1兆円）のクラウドサービス契約を新たに獲得し、今年10月から段階的に収益計上を開始すると明らかにした。 [e005:f10] 衛星インターネットサービス「Starlink」は依然として同社唯一の収益源であり、通信サービス事業の営業利益は前年同期比79%増の16.6億ドル（約2,600億円）に達し、グループ全体の財務を支えた。 [e005:f11] Starlinkの世界の有料契約者数は現在1,200万人と、前年同期から倍増したが、より多くの海外市場への進出や低価格プランの導入に伴い、契約者当たり平均収入（ARPU）は前年同期の85ドル（約1.3万円）から66ドル（約1万円）へと大幅に低下した。 [e005:f12] 全体として、SpaceXの第2四半期の株主帰属純損失は5.41億ドル（約850億円）、1株当たり損失は0.09ドル（約14円）となり、市場予想の1株当たり損失0.26ドル（約41円）を上回った。 [e005:f13] 決算説明会でマスク氏は、Starlinkが10年以内に世界の主要なインターネットサービスプロバイダーになる可能性があるとの見通しを語ったほか、Nvidia（NVDA）との深度ある協業計画も発表した。 [e005:f14] マスク氏はまた、同社のAIモデル「Grok」について、1.5兆のパラメータを持つ「Grok 4.6」バージョンを来週リリースし、今後3～4週間以内にさらに強力な「Grok 4.7」を公開すると予告した。 [e005:f15] 注目すべきは、SpaceXの株価が6月12日に1株150ドル（約2.4万円）で上場して以来、火曜日の終値までに累計で約16%下落していることだ。 [e005:f16] スターシップ計画についてマスク氏は、今年中に第3世代スターシップ「V3」の1段目と2段目の同時回収を試み、早ければ次の試験飛行で達成し、最初のV3版Starlink衛星を軌道に投入する可能性があると述べた。
